quad.about: First-run arthouse plus international and repertory programming.

roxy.about: 35mm, cult films, rare prints and indie releases.

angelika.about: One of NYC's classic first-run indie and foreign-film venues.

paris.about: Historic single-screen arthouse, now operated by Netflix.

wrt.about: Film at Lincoln Center: international, festival and repertory cinema.

ebm.about: Film at Lincoln Center: contemporary arthouse and international cinema.

bam.about: Indie, international, repertory and festival programming.

nhw.about: Indie and repertory programming with food and drinks.

nhp.about: The larger Nitehawk, with similarly strong programming.

spec.about: Tiny volunteer-run microcinema; underground, obscure, experimental and cult.

synd.about: Cinema and bar with cult, repertory and genre programming.

momi.about: Museum cinema with excellent retrospectives and special screenings.

maysles.about: Especially strong for documentary and socially engaged cinema.

udocs.about: Documentary, experimental work, artist talks and unconventional screenings.
